chunks: In the morning he came to the city, fearful and hesitant. Just then he who had asked him for help the day before called out for help (again). "You are indeed a meddlesome fellow," Moses said to him.

key_terms.لَغَوِيٌّ: a meddler or one who strays
key_terms.يَسْتَصْرِخُهُ: called out to him for help

ai.seo_question: What did Moses say to the man who asked for his help in the city?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the moment of Moses' (AS) impulsive strike, occurring while he was anxiously awaiting the outcome of his previous intervention. Shia scholars often interpret 'ghawiyyun mubin' as indicating a specific type of straying or misguidance, reflecting the man's persistent reliance on Moses rather than Allah. This incident serves as a pivotal lesson in prophetic humility, demonstrating that even a prophet is subject to divine correction for minor errors in judgment.
